question: P is the sister of Q. Q is the brother of R. R is the son of S. How is P related to S?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) P is the sister of Q.

2) Q is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e5138b9e7825877ba485e71747e51e224cebb72d2411160e912ff0e106ab534.png] 

3) R is the son of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75ab18440efd37f7dab34f0d91e6f5d98d3e16b611594751072dca4d121dd2a3.png] 

Thus, P is S's daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
